interface.longDescription: Search SciX (formerly NASA ADS), investigate article content, silently build a classified literature library, reuse complete versions, browse with adslib, and export citations. Explain this paper's figure and check the authors' conclusion.
Open my personal Web library with adslib and export BibTeX for a topic collection.
